conceptual_statement: Nevada research stays in six specialist products: the Nevada Transportation Authority household-goods CPCN roster for movers, the Division of Mortgage Lending framework with its enforcement index and HMDA activity, the State Contractors Board active license directory and discipline, the Division of Insurance framework and its own dated census, Health Care Quality and Compliance care classes beside CMS, and separate Nevada adviser registration lenses. Ask routes to those pages. It does not copy their records or add them into one Nevada total.

release_gate.rule: All six specialist /nevada pages must return HTTP 200 as intended state intelligence pages, indexable and self-canonical, and every hub must be CLOSED_PRODUCTION_VERIFIED at its certified SHA and fingerprint, before Ask /nevada is indexable. Any one specialist failure fails the gate.

intelligence_strip.grain: Distinct Nevada Transportation Authority household-goods CPCN numbers: 41 on the Active Mover list plus 5 proven by NTA-filed documents. Not USDOT or MC; exact USDOT/MC joins 0. The NTA prints no as-of date.

HMDA 2025 loan applications for Nevada properties: federal loan activity, not a lender, company or MLO count. 69,135 originations and 20,655 denials are separate measures. Lender licensing is verified on NMLS Consumer Access and the SRS search; no bulk roster.
Active license numbers in the Nevada State Contractors Board directory (Board as-of 9/25/2026 10:32:43 AM). License numbers, not contractors; 21,937 classification links are a different grain.

intelligence_strip.display: NDOI states 1,652 licensed insurers (as of October 2024)
intelligence_strip.grain: The Division of Insurance's own figure from its 2025 Market Report, dated October 2024. Not a September 2026 identity count and not a company list InsuranceTrustHub holds. Company, agency and producer bulk lists were not acquired.

intelligence_strip.display: 438 Nevada Residential Facility for Groups licenses
intelligence_strip.grain: Active HCQC RFG licenses (retrieved 2026-09-25). Only 74 hold the Assisted Living endorsement and 223 the Alzheimer's endorsement; an RFG is not assisted living by default. A state license is not CMS certification.

Firms with APPROVED Nevada state investment-adviser registration in IAPD (2026-09-17). 83 ERA (2026-09-17), 1,982 SEC notice filings (2026-09-18) and 99 principal-office firms (2026-08-27) are separate lenses with separate clocks.

what_makes_nevada_different: Move: the Nevada Transportation Authority issues household-goods CPCNs and keeps tariffs on file; a CPCN is not a USDOT or MC number, a tariff is not a quote, and an application is not a certificate.
Lender: the Division of Mortgage Lending licenses companies, MLOs and escrow through NMLS and its own SRS search, publishes no bulk roster, and keeps an enforcement index back to 2012.
Contractor: the State Contractors Board licenses businesses with A, B, AB and C classifications and a Board-set monetary limit; the qualified individual is a person, not the license holder.
Insurance: the Division of Insurance publishes its own licensee census only in its Market Report, dated October 2024; no current company, agency or producer bulk list was available.

Senior: a Residential Facility for Groups is assisted living only with the state Assisted Living endorsement; Health Care Quality and Compliance also licenses SNFs, Homes for Individual Residential Care, Home Health and hospice, separately from CMS certification.

Investor: Nevada state IA registration, exempt reporting advisers, SEC notice filings and principal-office firms are separate lenses with separate dates; Securities Division actions were not acquired and no other regulator is substituted.

CROSS_HUB_RECORD_TOTAL.explanation: Nevada evidence uses incompatible grains: household-goods CPCN identities, HMDA loan applications, mortgage enforcement index rows, contractor license numbers and classification links, discipline rows, a dated insurance-regulator census, care-class licenses and endorsements, inspection-index rows and sanctions, and adviser registrations, ERA and notice filings. They cannot be summed into a Nevada business, provider, professional or record total.

hubs.plain_question: How is mortgage lending licensed in Nevada?
hubs.coverage_summary: MLD regulation mapped; licenses verified on NMLS Consumer Access and the SRS search; 189 enforcement index rows (2012-2026), 188 linked documents; HMDA 2025 activity.
hubs.coverage_limitation: No Nevada bulk company, MLO, branch or escrow roster (NOT_ACQUIRED). Order documents read 2019-2026 only. Provider-level complaints not acquired. HMDA is federal loan activity, not a lender count.

hubs.coverage_summary: Nevada State Contractors Board active directory: 19,213 active license numbers and 21,937 license-to-classification links; 609 disciplinary and Board action rows.
hubs.coverage_limitation: Active licenses only. License numbers are not contractors. Qualified individuals not acquired in bulk. A monetary limit is not revenue or quality. Discipline attaches only by exact license number (287 rows).

hubs.plain_question: How does Nevada regulate insurers, agencies and producers?
hubs.coverage_summary: Nevada Division of Insurance framework; NDOI's 2025 Market Report states its own census as of October 2024; one current enforcement order listed; complaint-reason rows 2022-2024.
hubs.coverage_limitation: Company, agency and producer bulk lists NOT_ACQUIRED. NDOI-stated figures keep their October 2024 clock and are not current identity counts. Complaint rows are reasons, not complaints or company rates.
